title: Wynncraft forum member profiles — public guild-history fields
note: Curated extracts from public Wynncraft forum member profiles, read 4 Sep 2026. Only fields bearing on guild history are recorded: forum join date, message count, rank title, the guild shown on the profile, and any guild offices the profile lists. The profiles also expose birthday, location and occupation fields; those are real-world personal details and are deliberately NOT recorded here, in line with the rule that player articles carry public in-game and forum facts only. Each entry links to the profile it came from so the reading can be rechecked.
